set: Aviary Cards - Bird Squad-original legends and field qualities
note: Aviary cards are Bird Squad-original cards, not tarot cards. The first six are legendary field myths; the quality expansion adds lower-rarity bird-behavior cards with no suit and no tarot numbering requirement.
coreRule: All subjects anatomically bird; streetwear fitted to bird anatomy; no humanoid forms; no gore. No readable text on clothing; suit-coded streetwear should use abstract motifs, color, material, and accessories without gang-coded uniforms or affiliation marks.

style.composition: vertical Bird Squad card with shared master border frame, full-body bird subject, and readable bottom title cartouche
style.borderSystem: Fixed master frame structure: dark outer keyline, gilded inner filigree rail, four corner medallions, slim vertical side rails, top badge or crest medallion, and bottom title cartouche. Aviary cards reuse the master border without treating the card as tarot.

cards.coreMeaning: The great journey, endurance, collective destiny, no turning back
cards.description: A long-haul flier mid-crossing over an endless dusk skyline, the longest road of all.
cards.pose: Powerful sustained flight high over the city, wings fully extended, distant flock strung out behind toward the horizon.
cards.varietyNotes: Pairs thematically with the Major World (Arctic Tern) but is endurance over completion; sustained-flight silhouette + trailing flock are its signature.
cards.gameplayFantasy: An endgame journey engine — long-payoff card that rewards committing to a course across many turns.

cards.coreMeaning: Sanctuary, rest, belonging, the safe return, community shelter
cards.description: A guardian of the communal roost-tower welcoming the flock home at last light.
cards.pose: Perched at the mouth of a glowing colony-tower, wings spread in a sheltering arc, others settling in behind.
cards.varietyNotes: Glowing tower + sheltering wing arc make it the deck's 'safe haven' card; warm amber separates it from the cool night cards.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A safe-harbor card — heal, regroup, and protect crew cards; recall pieces home and refresh them.

cards.coreMeaning: Upheaval, raw forces, riding chaos, harnessing what you cannot control
cards.description: A storm-rider angled into the gale, throat-pouch flaring, thriving where others flee.
cards.pose: Banking hard on a thermal inside a wall of storm cloud, wings cocked, lightning behind, fully in command of the chaos.
cards.varietyNotes: Forked-tail, angular storm-rider silhouette; contrasts the Major Tower (sudden collapse) by being sustained mastery of chaos.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A high-risk/high-reward swing card — convert disruption into power; stronger the more chaotic the encounter.

cards.coreMeaning: Transformation of self, shedding an old identity, vulnerability inside change, renewal
cards.description: A bird caught between two selves — brilliant plumage giving way to a quieter new coat.
cards.pose: Mid-preen on a branch, half its feathers vivid scarlet and half shifting to muted green-gold, loose feathers drifting down.
cards.varietyNotes: Two-tone split plumage is a unique visual hook in the deck; dramatizes 'becoming' without gore or harm.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A transform card — swap a card's form/role, trading current strength for a new shape (vulnerable mid-change).

cards.coreMeaning: Unity, emergence, the many-as-one, collective will, strength in numbers
cards.description: A single small bird at the leading edge of a vast murmuration that moves as one mind.
cards.pose: One sharp foreground bird with an immense swirling flock behind forming a single shifting shape across the sky.
cards.varietyNotes: Foreground individual + emergent flock-shape is the deck's only crowd-as-subject composition; reads 'collective' instantly.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A swarm/go-wide card — power scales with how many friendly crew cards are active in the encounter; rewards a full crew.

cards.coreMeaning: Liminality, hidden truth, omen, the threshold between states
cards.description: A masked, motionless watcher at the moment the light goes out — neither day nor night.
cards.pose: Frozen upright against a branch in perfect camouflage, eyes thin slits, a ringed eclipse-sun directly behind its head.
cards.varietyNotes: Camouflaged stillness + eclipse halo; sits beside the Major Moon (illusion) but is threshold/omen rather than dream. Corona gold is its one point of light.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A liminal/omen card — peek at hidden information or freeze the encounter state for a beat before a turn flips.

cards.coreMeaning: Precision, timing, staying steady inside impossible motion
cards.description: A tiny city courier holds a perfect hover beside a rain-slick signal light, reading the exact instant to move.
cards.pose: Suspended in a sharp hover with wings blurred by pixel clusters, beak angled toward a tiny timing marker clipped to a rooftop rail.
cards.varietyNotes: Tiny scale, suspended pose, and throat-glint timing separate it from Plumes speed cards; this is control, not spectacle.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A low-cost filter card that fixes timing: draw, discard, and lightly brace while keeping the turn moving.

cards.coreMeaning: Warning, group nerve, turning pressure back on a threat
cards.description: A shoulder-patched sentinel leans into a hard alarm call from a chain-link rooftop, making a larger foe hesitate.
cards.pose: Perched forward with red epaulets flared, beak open in a sharp call, body angled at an unseen incoming threat.
cards.varietyNotes: Epaulet flare and alarm-call posture make the bird quality readable without needing a named heroic individual.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A modest strike that punishes attacking enemies by adding Winded.

cards.coreMeaning: Protective misdirection, brave vulnerability, keeping the fragile thing safe
cards.description: A plover draws attention away from a hidden sidewalk nest, one wing lowered in a deliberate act of protection.
cards.pose: Low to the pavement with one wing drooped naturally, head turned bright-eyed toward danger while the real safe place sits behind.
cards.varietyNotes: Grounded sidewalk-nest staging and broken-wing-display behavior give this card a tender defensive identity.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A gentle sustain card: Cover plus a little healing, stronger as a Molt-softening shelter.

cards.coreMeaning: Spotting loose value, breaking open defenses, practical opportunism
cards.description: A dockside gull clocks the one unsecured latch on a market crate while the whole rooftop misses it.
cards.pose: Standing alert on a wet pier rail, head cocked at a loose latch, with one foot braced and wings tucked cleanly.
cards.varietyNotes: A utilitarian gull card about noticing weakness; it should feel clever and funny without becoming slapstick.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Anti-Cover utility that cracks enemy Cover and replaces itself.

cards.coreMeaning: Patience, altitude, borrowed momentum, spending less by reading the air
cards.description: A vast-winged condor rides warm city air above solar vents and roof exhausts without wasting a beat.
cards.pose: Huge wings locked in a calm soar over rooftop vents, body barely tilted as the city heat carries it upward.
streetwear: wide weather cloak fitted over folded wing base
cards.varietyNotes: Massive calm silhouette and thermal-vent setting make it the opposite of frantic speed cards.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A tempo setup card: gain Wingbeat, future draw, and Open Sky protection when the flock is exposed.

cards.coreMeaning: Remembered resources, social memory, getting back what the flock set aside
cards.description: A blue jay-mapkeeper retrieves a tagged cache from a cracked planter exactly when the route needs it.
cards.pose: Perched beside a rooftop planter cache, beak lifting one tagged seed packet from many hidden spots mapped by memory.
cards.varietyNotes: Memory and retrieval are the point; keep the props practical, small, and route-used rather than magical.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A fair recursion card that returns a discard card, with extra draw when the flock is healthy.

cards.coreMeaning: Endurance through cold, shared warmth, patient protection
cards.description: A massive penguin anchors a winter transit platform, sheltering the flock from crosswind and exhaustion.
cards.pose: Standing square and monumental, flippers close to the body, a warm protected space suggested at its feet without adding another species.
cards.varietyNotes: Tall grounded mass, warmth, and endurance set it apart from flashier defense cards.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A sturdy Cover card that helps more when Cohesion is low.

cards.coreMeaning: Adaptation, borrowed voices, stitching the flock's habits into one answer
cards.description: A slate-gray mimic threads four different neighborhood calls into one live counter-call from a fire escape.
cards.pose: Balanced on a fire escape rail with tail cocked, beak open mid-phrase, subtle visual echoes of four suit behaviors around the scene.
cards.varietyNotes: The rare glue card: one bird voice braids suit habits without becoming any suit or importing their border symbols.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A flexible rare payoff that rewards whatever suit the player has already played this turn.

cards.coreMeaning: Attention, opening rhythm, the first clear signal through noise
cards.description: A spotted woodpecker hammers a bright rhythm on a rooftop vent, turning scattered city noise into a usable start.
cards.pose: Braced against a metal vent cap with tail stiff for support, beak mid-tap, spotted body angled in a clean drumming silhouette.
cards.varietyNotes: A biological signal card: rhythm comes from beak and braced tail, not electronics or magical sound waves.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A simple opener that pings all enemies and gives Plumes-adjacent tempo only on the first play.

cards.coreMeaning: Scrappy footing, awkward grace, staying upright on bad ground
cards.description: A coot with oversized lobed toes scrambles across a slick curb and somehow turns the wobble into momentum.
cards.pose: Low stepping over wet curb stones, lobed feet visible and planted wide, wings tucked tight for balance.
cards.varietyNotes: The humor is in the species anatomy: awkward-looking footwork that is actually excellent.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A defensive tempo card that pays back one Wingbeat while adding modest Cover.

cards.coreMeaning: Careful inspection, patient loops, finding value by circling back
cards.description: A tiny creeper works up a brick wall in a spiral route, checking every crack before vanishing around the corner.
cards.pose: Clinging vertically to a brick wall with tail braced, curved bill pointed into a small crack, body small but exact.
cards.varietyNotes: A small quiet card about persistence; keep the scale intimate and wall-clinging, not heroic flight.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A low-impact self-loop that adds tiny Cover and keeps coming back through the draw pile.

cards.coreMeaning: Poise, light footing, calm on a narrow stem
cards.description: A small reedling splits its weight between swaying rail wires, making a fragile crossing look easy.
cards.pose: Perched in a perfect side-split stance between two flexible wires, tail counterbalancing, head calm and alert.
cards.varietyNotes: Balance and calm are the hook; no acrobatics that read as humanoid gymnastics.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A common sustain card that gives Cover, a little healing, and a draw bonus when the flock is already steady.

cards.coreMeaning: Commitment, clean entry, claiming the opening through resistance
cards.description: An osprey drops through rain toward a guarded rooftop pool, talons forward and eyes locked on the one true opening.
cards.pose: Descending in a controlled plunge with talons extended naturally, wings angled back, gaze fixed below.
cards.varietyNotes: Distinct from raptor authority cards: this is a plunge and grip moment, not command or predation gore.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A clean anti-Cover strike using piercing damage and extra Cover removal.

cards.coreMeaning: Going under pressure, surfacing clean, resilience in rough current
cards.description: A compact river bird dives under a cold spillway and pops back onto a pipe with the route still in its beak.
cards.pose: Half-emerged from rushing water near a drainpipe, white throat bright, feet gripping slick metal.
cards.varietyNotes: Water resilience without Basin identity: this is pressure tolerance and Open Sky recovery, not care-taking.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Open Sky survival that heals, guards, and replaces itself when the flock is exposed.

cards.coreMeaning: Shared effort, drafting, letting formation carry the tired wing
cards.description: A goose holds the lead angle in a street-canyon V, turning headwind between buildings into shared lift.
cards.pose: Strong forward flight with neck extended and wings broad, city canyon behind forming a subtle V-shaped lane.
cards.varietyNotes: Formation is suggested by city geometry and same-species silhouettes only if needed; avoid crowd clutter.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A formation glue card that rewards suit-heavy Plumes or Nests decks while staying suitless.

cards.coreMeaning: Tool use, clever access, solving the route with the right small instrument
cards.description: A crow shapes a hooked probe from scrap wire and reaches the one latch the flock could not open by force.
cards.pose: Perched beside a locked utility box, beak holding a bent wire tool, eyes focused on the hidden latch.
cards.varietyNotes: The rare intelligence card: practical tool use, no magic, no sci-fi interface, no readable schematics.
cards.gameplayFantasy: A premium recursion card that retrieves the exact discard card and refunds tempo the first time it is used.
